source:
@@U03389@@
I must admit, in the twilight’s glimmer you ladies really seem quite tempting. I can’t complain about you, now can I?

@@U03391@@
(Barging her way among them.)

@@U03392@@
Nor about me! Let me join you, won't you?

@@U03394@@
No, not her! She spoils our fun!

@@U03396@@
(To 梅菲斯特.)

@@U03397@@
Greetings from 恩普萨, cousin! The sweetheart with the ass’s foot? Though you have only a horse’s hoof, I greet you all the same, don’t you know.

@@U03399@@
I thought there'd be only strangers, but now there are relatives! Ah! The Devil’s book’s both old and huge: nothing but cousins from the 哈尔茨 here to Hellas.

@@U03401@@
I’m known not to dawdle but know in a flash what form of many forms to assume. In your honor, though, I’ve chosen this ass’s head.

@@U03403@@
I note that these people are keen on kinship; and yet I make no bones about disclaiming this ass’s head.

@@U03405@@
Forget it! Forget that filthy old hag!
translation:
@@U03389@@
我必须承认，在暮色的微光中，你们这些女士看起来确实很诱人。我不能抱怨你，现在可以吗？

@@U03391@@
（闯入他们中间。）

@@U03392@@
也不关我的事！让我加入你，好吗？

@@U03394@@
不，不是她！她破坏了我们的乐趣！

@@U03396@@
（对梅菲斯特。）

@@U03397@@
来自恩普萨的问候，表弟！屁股脚的甜心？虽然你只有马蹄，但我还是向你打招呼，你不知道吗？

@@U03399@@
本以为只有陌生人，现在却是亲戚了！啊!魔鬼的书既古老又庞大：除了从这里的哈尔茨到希腊的表兄弟之外什么也没有。

@@U03401@@
众所周知，我不会磨磨蹭蹭，但很快就知道要采取多种形式中的哪种形式。不过，为了你的荣誉，我选择了这头驴的头。

@@U03403@@
我注意到这些人热衷于亲属关系；但我毫不犹豫地拒绝承认这头驴的头。

@@U03405@@
算了！忘记那个肮脏的老太婆吧！
